summary.headline: Astrological Calculations and Psellus Chapters
summary.text: Catalog entry for folios 310–375 describing astrological calculations for life and death, planetary significations and planetary hours, a thief’s prayer, hieroglyphic letters, and Michael Psellus’s chapters on omnifarious doctrine, earthquakes, hot waters, elements, clouds, thunder, and lightning.
